naslov: Mavericks exercise 2027-28 option on Zaccharie Risacher deal
tekst:
The Dallas Mavericks exercised the fourth-year team option in forward Zaccharie Risacher's contract, guaranteeing his $17.4 million salary next season.
The Mavericks acquired Risacher, the No. 1 pick in the 2024 draft, from the Atlanta Hawks in a three-way trade during the offseason.
The 6-foot-9 Risacher has averaged 8.0 points, 6.0 rebounds, 1.5 assists, 2.0 steals and 2.0 blocks through four games this season with the Mavericks.
Risacher has career averages of 11.1 points and 2.8 rebounds, starting 120 of the 146 games he has appeared in for Atlanta and Dallas.
